# Mudra (Mudra Clothing Company)

> Mudra is an Indian streetwear label from Pune making oversized graphic t-shirts: a small print on the front, the full graphic on the back. Online store: www.wearmudra.shop. Instagram: @wear.mudra.

Also known as: Wear Mudra, wearmudra, wearmudra.shop, wear.mudra, Mudra, Mudra Clothing Co., Mudra Clothing.
Contact: abhijeet@wearmudra.shop. Free shipping across India.

## T-shirts

- [Face Card Oversized Graphic T-Shirt](https://www.wearmudra.shop/p/face-card): A playing card for people who walk into a room and let their face do the talking. Face Card is a Y2K graphic t-shirt built around a king card, mirrored top and bottom the way real cards are, with the words “Face Card” across the middle. It’s the internet’s favourite compliment, printed where everyone behind you can read it. Wear it to the party, the wedding or the queue at the chai stall. The card does the rest. ₹1,299.
- [Neo Bombay Oversized Graphic T-Shirt](https://www.wearmudra.shop/p/neo-bombay): Mumbai at night, if it were a video game. Neo Bombay is a retro graphic t-shirt with a full game screen on the back: a pink sunset, palm trees, a skyline, a sports car, a wanted level and a mission list that reads reach the airport, lose the tail, do not look back. A row of stars sits on the chest, three of them filled, so only the people who’ve played the game will get it. Press any key to continue. ₹1,299.
- [Not Responding Oversized Graphic T-Shirt](https://www.wearmudra.shop/p/not-responding): For the days your brain has too many tabs open. Not Responding is a Y2K graphic t-shirt with a stack of old computer error windows on the back, the kind that appeared just before everything froze. It’s for Monday mornings, group projects and the fifth reminder about a deadline you already knew about. No restart required. You’ll come back online eventually, probably after lunch. ₹1,199.
- [Atlas Oversized Graphic T-Shirt](https://www.wearmudra.shop/p/atlas): Named after the Titan who held up the sky and never once skipped a day. Atlas is a gym graphic t-shirt for the ones who show up at six, load the bar and don’t post about it. It’s for leg day, back day and every day you thought about not going and went anyway. Wear it to the gym, or wear it to carry the group project. The weight is roughly the same. ₹1,199.
- [One Way Oversized Graphic T-Shirt](https://www.wearmudra.shop/p/one-way): A boarding pass with no return date. One Way is a travel graphic t-shirt with a ticket printed on the back, from home to away, for the trip you keep planning in the group chat. It’s for airports, train stations, long bus rides and the moment you finally book the thing. Some people collect fridge magnets. Some people just keep going. Seat by the window, if you can get one. ₹1,099.
- [Out of Office Oversized Graphic T-Shirt](https://www.wearmudra.shop/p/out-of-office): Your auto-reply, but wearable. Out of Office is a travel graphic t-shirt with a luggage tag on the back, for the version of you that has stopped checking email. It’s made for beach towns, hill stations and any holiday where your phone stays in the bag. Leave the laptop at home. Leave the meetings to someone else. You’ll respond to all messages on your return, maybe. ₹1,099.
- [The Overthinker Oversized Graphic T-Shirt](https://www.wearmudra.shop/p/the-overthinker): Card IX in a tarot deck is the Hermit, the one who goes quiet to think. We redrew it for the rest of us. The Overthinker is a tarot graphic t-shirt with a figure whose head is a tangle of scribbled thoughts, moons on either side and an open hand with an eye in the palm. It’s for 3 AM ceilings, unread replies and conversations you’re still replaying from last week. You’ve already thought about this enough. Wear it. ₹1,299.
